lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: COLLEGE YEAR 1! Maingay ang busina ng jeepney sa U-Belt, malakas ang hangin mula sa LRT, at nakasabit na sa leeg mo ang bagong University ID lanyard para sa {course}!
lines.textEn: COLLEGE YEAR 1! Jeepney horns echo down U-Belt, the LRT rattles overhead, and your shiny new {course} university ID lanyard hangs around your neck!

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Freshie na tayo, {name}! Tingnan mo 'yung pila sa Registrar at Accounting — mas mahaba pa sa pila ng libreng lugaw!
lines.textEn: We are officially freshies, {name}! Look at the Registrar and Accounting queue — longer than a free lugaw line!

choices.text: Pumila nang maaga sa Registrar para makakuha ng magandang schedule!
choices.textEn: Queue early at the Registrar to grab good class schedules!

journal.title: College Freshman ({course})
journal.summary: Nagsimula ang buhay kolehiyo mo sa {course}! Handa na sa bagong hamon.
journal.summaryEn: Started college life in {course}! Ready for the biggest journey yet.

choices.text: Mag-campus tour muna kasama si Miggy para hanapin ang pinakamura na kainan!
choices.textEn: Scout campus with Miggy to find the cheapest meal spots first!

lines.speaker: Aling Nena
lines.text: O, {name}! May bakante pa akong bedspace malapit sa gate — at kung uwian ka naman, bukas pa rin ang carinderia ko para sa budget meals at part-time shifts!
lines.textEn: Hey, {name}! I have a bedspace slot near the campus gate — and if you commute, my carinderia is still open for budget meals and shifts!

lines.speaker: Aling Nena
lines.text: Tandaan mo lang ha: bawal ang electric kettle na patago, at bawal ang laging late sa bayad. Pero kapag masipag ka, aalagaan kita.
lines.textEn: Just remember: no secret electric kettles, and no skipping rent. Work hard and I will look out for you.

choices.text: Magbayad ng deposit / meal card nang maayos (-₱400).
choices.textEn: Pay the initial deposit / student meal pass cleanly (-₱400).

choices.text: Makiusap na hulugan sa susunod na linggo — kapalit ng tulong sa carinderia.
choices.textEn: Ask to pay in installments next week in exchange for kitchen help.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Welcome sa {course}! Kung akala niyo mahirap na ang SHS, dito niyo makikita ang tunay na laban. Singko kung hindi nag-aaral, uno kung pursigido.
lines.textEn: Welcome to {course}! If you thought SHS was tough, wait until midterms here. 5.0 if you slack off, 1.0 if you earn it.

choices.text: Umupo sa front row at magtanong tungkol sa grading syllabus!
choices.textEn: Sit in the front row and ask smart questions about the syllabus!

choices.text: Umupo malapit sa electric fan sa likod — survive muna ang init!
choices.textEn: Grab a seat beside the wall fan in back — survive the tropical heat!

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: ORG FAIR WEEK! {name}, sumali ka sa {course} Society at Student Volunteers! May libreng reviewers mula sa seniors, plus network para sa OJT at scholarships!
lines.textEn: ORG FAIR WEEK! {name}, join the {course} Society and Student Volunteers! Free senior reviewers, plus OJT and scholarship connections!

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: Sasali din ako, {name}... ₱120 lang naman ang org fee plus libre na raw ang lanyard!
lines.textEn: I am signing up too, {name}... membership is only ₱120 and comes with a lanyard!

choices.text: Sumali sa org kasama sina Carlo at Jamie! (-₱120)
choices.textEn: Join the org with Carlo and Jamie! (-₱120)

choices.text: Mag-volunteer sa booth kapalit ng waived membership fee!
choices.textEn: Volunteer to run their booth so they waive your membership fee!

choices.text: Pass muna — kailangan ko tipirin ang oras para sa part-time work.
choices.textEn: Pass for now — I need every hour for part-time work.

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: Welcome sa org! Eto agad ang secret weapon: Google Drive dump ng past exams at reviewers! Huwag mo lang ipagkalat kay Sir Reyes ha!
lines.textEn: Welcome to the org! Here is our secret weapon: an offline archive of past exams and study guides! Just do not tell Sir Reyes!

choices.text: Salamat Carlo! Solid 'to para sa midterms!
choices.textEn: Thanks Carlo! Huge boost for midterms!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: UNANG MAJOR EXAM SA COLLEGE! Tahimik ang buong hall maliban sa tunog ng calculator at electric fan. Parang alien language 'yung Number 4 at 5!
lines.textEn: FIRST MAJOR COLLEGE EXAM! The room is dead silent except for clicking calculators and humming fans. Questions 4 and 5 look like alien hieroglyphics!

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Ten minutes remaining! Walang titingin sa katabi. Ipakita ninyo kung karapat-dapat kayo sa {course}.
lines.textEn: Ten minutes remaining! Eyes on your own booklet. Show me you belong in {course}.

choices.text: Gamitin ang lahat ng natutunan at i-double check ang bawat solusyon.
choices.textEn: Stay calm and double-check every solution methodically.

choices.text: Magsulat ng partial credit solutions sa lahat ng hirap na items!
choices.textEn: Write neat partial-credit workings on every tough question!

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Grabe 'yung exam na 'yun, parang sinampal ako ng realidad! Tara, mag-palit tayo ng notes bago mag-finals!
lines.textEn: That exam slapped my soul straight out of my body! Let us trade notes before finals!

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Okay lang 'yan! Basta hindi tres pababa, buhay pa ang pangarap. Tulungan tayo sa group study!
lines.textEn: Deep breaths! As long as we pass, the dream lives. We will carry each other in group study!

choices.text: I-share ang notes mo at patawanin si Miggy.
choices.textEn: Share your notes and cheer Miggy up.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: TUITION DEADLINE WEEK! May notice sa student portal: 'No Exam Permit without Partial Payment.' Nakipag-video call ka kay Mama sa labas ng gate.
lines.textEn: TUITION DEADLINE WEEK! The portal flashes red: 'No Exam Permit without Partial Payment.' You call Mama right outside the school gate.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Anak, may konting pera kami pero kulang pa para sa tuition mo sa {course}. Pasensya na, {name}... susubukan ni Tatay mag-overtime ngayong weekend.
lines.textEn: Anak, we scraped some money together, but it is still short for your {course} tuition. I am so sorry, {name}... Tatay is trying to pick up weekend overtime.

choices.text: Mag-part-time ako ngayong linggo para punan ang kulang! (Working Student)
choices.textEn: I will take part-time shifts this week to cover the balance!

choices.text: Mangutang muna sa kaklase at mag-promissory note sa Accounting (+₱1,500, utang).
choices.textEn: Borrow from a classmate and file a promissory note (+₱1,500 cash now).

choices.text: Bayaran agad mula sa sarili mong ipon (-₱1,800).
choices.textEn: Pay directly out of your own hard-earned savings (-₱1,800).

lines.speaker: Shift Manager
lines.text: Hiring kami ng student crew ngayon! Flexible sa class schedule, may meal stub pa bawat shift. Kaya mo ba ang lunch rush ng fastfood?
lines.textEn: We are hiring working-student crew right now! Flexible around classes, plus a free meal stub every shift. Can you handle the lunch rush?

choices.text: Tanggapin at mag-trial shift ngayon! (Play Fastfood Crew)
choices.textEn: Accept and jump straight into the trial shift! (Play Fastfood Crew)

choices.text: Salamat po! I-schedule ko 'to sa weekly planner ko.
choices.textEn: Thank you! I will schedule shifts in my weekly planner.

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Bro, alam kong mabigat ang tuition, pero ingat ka sa utang ha — nakakastress 'yan pag sabay-sabay na ang singilan bago finals. Sabihan mo ako pag kailangan mo ng raket!
lines.textEn: Hey, I know tuition is brutal, just be careful with borrowing — repayment stress hits hard before finals. Tell me whenever you need a side hustle!

choices.text: Salamat Miggy, babayaran ko agad 'to sa unang kita ko.
choices.textEn: Thanks Miggy, I will pay this back the moment I earn.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Biglang bumuhos ang malakas na ulan paglabas ng 6PM class! Stranded ang lahat sa waiting shed at abot-sakong na ang baha sa kanto.
lines.textEn: A sudden monsoon downpour hits right after your 6 PM lecture! Everyone crowds under the waiting shed as ankle-deep floodwater pools on the avenue.

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: {name}! Wala akong dalang payong at basang-basa na 'yung notes ko... pwedeng makisukob hanggang sakayan ng jeep?
lines.textEn: {name}! I forgot my umbrella and my notebooks are soaking... could I share yours to the jeepney stop?

choices.text: Syempre! I-share ang payong at ilibre ng mainit na sopas sa kanto (-₱70).
choices.textEn: Of course! Share your umbrella and grab hot sopas together (-₱70).

choices.text: Ibigay kay Jamie ang payong mo at tumakbo ka sa ulan para protektahan ang notes niya!
choices.textEn: Hand Jamie your umbrella and dash through the rain to protect their notes!

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: Alam mo, {name}, sobrang hanga ako sa'yo. Kahit ang hirap ng schedule at budget, hindi ka nagrereklamo nang sobra — laging may ngiti pa rin. Sana sabay tayo hanggang graduation.
lines.textEn: You know, {name}, I really admire you. Even with impossible schedules and tight budgets, you still keep smiling. I hope we walk that graduation stage together.

choices.text: 'Promise, Jamie — sabay tayong mag-toga balang araw!'
choices.textEn: 'Promise, Jamie — we are wearing those togas together someday!'

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Tapos na ang 1st Semester Finals ng College Year 1! Nakapaskil na ang class cards at portal grades.
lines.textEn: College Year 1, 1st Semester Finals are complete! Grades are posting on the student portal.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Unang semestre pa lang 'to, pero malinaw na kung sino ang may grit. Good job sa mga nakapasa — bawi naman sa 2nd sem ang mga nag-alanganin!
lines.textEn: Only the first semester, yet grit already shows. Well done to those who passed — bounce back next term if you stumbled!

choices.text: Mag-check ng grades at magpasalamat sa barkada!
choices.textEn: Check your grades and celebrate with the barkada!

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: 2nd Semester na! Nakakuha ka ba ng magandang profs? Sabay-sabay na ang minor at major subjects ngayon!
lines.textEn: 2nd Semester! Did you snag good professors? Majors and minors are stacking up now!

choices.text: Bumili ng secondhand textbooks sa Recto / seniors (-₱280, +GWA).
choices.textEn: Buy secondhand textbooks from seniors (-₱280, +GWA).

choices.text: Hiram muna sa library at makishare ng PDF sa barkada (Free).
choices.textEn: Borrow from the library and share PDFs with friends (Free).

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 11:30 PM — biglang nag-brownout sa buong street habang may 12AM online submission ka! 14% na lang ang battery ng phone mo!
lines.textEn: 11:30 PM — sudden brownout hits the entire street with a midnight online submission looming! Your phone is at 14% battery!

lines.speaker: Aling Nena
lines.text: Naku, may emergency powerbank ako dito, {name}! O kaya tumakbo ka muna sa 24-hour study cafe sa kanto!
lines.textEn: Oh dear, I have a spare powerbank here, {name}! Or run to the 24-hour study cafe down the block!

choices.text: Hiramin ang powerbank ni Aling Nena at mag-tether ng mobile data (-₱50 load).
choices.textEn: Borrow Aling Nena's powerbank and tether prepaid data (-₱50 load).

choices.text: Pumunta sa 24-hour cafe para matapos nang pulido (-₱140 coffee, -Energy).
choices.textEn: Head to the 24-hour cafe to polish the paper (-₱140 coffee, -Energy).

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Midterms ng 2nd Sem! Ang sabi ng registrar, nag-open ulit ng Academic Scholarship slots para sa may GWA na 1.75 pababa!
lines.textEn: 2nd Sem Midterms! The registrar announced new Academic Scholarship slots for students maintaining 1.75 GWA or better!

choices.text: Subukan ang Scholarship Application Quest ngayon!
choices.textEn: Attempt the Scholarship Application Quest right now!

choices.text: Mag-focus muna sa pagpasa ng midterm exams (+GWA, -Energy).
choices.textEn: Focus purely on acing your midterm exams (+GWA, -Energy).

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Singilan na naman ng 2nd Semester balance bago Finals! Hawak mo ang assessment form habang nagkukwenta ng bawat barya.
lines.textEn: 2nd Semester tuition balance is due before Finals! You study the assessment slip, counting every peso.

choices.text: Bayaran ang tuition installment ngayon (-₱1,400).
choices.textEn: Pay the tuition installment right now (-₱1,400).

choices.text: Mag-raket muna bilang jeepney konduktor / crew para pandagdag! (Play Jeepney Fare)
choices.textEn: Hustle an emergency shift to raise cash first! (Play Jeepney Fare)

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: SURVIVED COLLEGE YEAR 1! Mula sa nakakaligaw na unang araw hanggang sa mga gabing walang tulog — sophomore ka na next sem!
lines.textEn: SURVIVED COLLEGE YEAR 1! From getting lost on day one to sleepless exam weeks — you are officially a sophomore next term!

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Hindi na tayo freshies, {name}! Tatlong taon na lang, martsa na!
lines.textEn: No longer freshies, {name}! Three more years and we march!

choices.text: Magdiwang kasama ang barkada at umuwi muna kay Mama (+Mental, +Energy).
choices.textEn: Celebrate with the barkada and visit Mama (+Mental, +Energy).

journal.title: Tapos na ang 1st Year College!
journal.summary: Nalampasan mo ang unang taon sa {course} sa kabila ng tuition, puyat, at barya-baryang budget.
journal.summaryEn: Survived Freshman year in {course} through tuition crunches, late nights, and tight coins.

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Petsa de peligro na naman! ₱35 siomai rice na may unli chili garlic at sabaw — ang pambansang ulam ng mga college student!
lines.textEn: End-of-week broke era again! ₱35 siomai rice with unlimited chili garlic and soup — the national dish of Filipino college students!

choices.text: Order ng isang siomai rice + extra sabaw (-₱35).
choices.textEn: Order siomai rice with free extra soup (-₱35).

choices.text: Tumulong maghugas ng plato kapalit ng libreng adobo meal!
choices.textEn: Wash dishes for 20 minutes in exchange for a full adobo meal!

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: {name}! Binebenta ng graduating senior natin 'yung secondhand laptop niya sa ₱1,500 lang (hulugan o cash) — may konting gasgas pero mabilis pa pang-Word, Excel, at freelance!
lines.textEn: {name}! A graduating senior is selling a secondhand laptop for just ₱1,500 — scratched lid, but still fast for papers and freelance gigs!

choices.text: Bilhin ang secondhand laptop! (-₱1,500, unlocks Freelance Gigs!)
choices.textEn: Buy the secondhand laptop! (-₱1,500, unlocks Freelance Gigs!)

journal.title: Unang Secondhand Laptop
journal.summary: Nakabili ka ng secondhand laptop mula sa senior — bukas na ang freelance gigs!
journal.summaryEn: Bought a secondhand laptop from a senior — freelance gigs are now unlocked!

choices.text: Pass muna — stick na lang sa computer lab ng school.
choices.textEn: Pass for now — I will keep using the campus computer lab.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: {name}, naiwan ko sa boarding house 'yung coin purse ko! Pwede bang makihiram ng ₱100 pamasahe at pang-photocopy? Babayaran ko rin sa Lunes!
lines.textEn: {name}, I left my coin purse at the dorm! Could I borrow ₱100 for fare and photocopies? I will pay you back Monday!

choices.text: Eto ₱100, Bea! Tulungan tayo dito.
choices.textEn: Here is ₱100, Bea! We have each other's backs.

choices.text: ₱40 lang kaya ko i-share ngayon, sakto lang din pera ko eh.
choices.textEn: I can only spare ₱40 right now, my wallet is razor-thin too.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: {name}, maganda ang class standing mo ngayong semestre. May student assistant opening sa department next week — may maliit na allowance at free printing!
lines.textEn: {name}, your standing this semester is impressive. There is a student assistant opening next week — comes with a stipend and free printing!

choices.text: Tanggapin ang Student Assistant gig! (+₱420, +GWA, -Energy)
choices.textEn: Accept the Student Assistant gig! (+₱420, +GWA, -Energy)

choices.text: Magpasalamat pero ipaubaya sa mas nangangailangan.
choices.textEn: Thank Sir kindly and pass it to a classmate who needs it more.

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Stress reliever! ₱5 per song lang sa videoke sa kanto — kakanta daw si Carlo ng Eraserheads!
lines.textEn: Stress relief time! ₱5 per song at the corner videoke — Carlo is about to belt Eraserheads!

choices.text: Maki-duet at mag-enjoy nang isang oras! (-₱55)
choices.textEn: Belt out a duet and unwind for an hour! (-₱55)

choices.text: Manood lang nang sandali tapos balik review sa dorm.
choices.textEn: Cheer for one song then head back to review.

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: ALERT! May libreng career seminar sa auditorium — at ang balita ko, may libreng Jolli-spaghetti at certificate para sa attendees!
lines.textEn: ALERT! Free career seminar at the auditorium — word is there is free packed spaghetti and an attendance certificate!

choices.text: Takbo sa auditorium! Libreng pagkain at learning!
choices.textEn: Sprint to the auditorium! Free food and a certificate!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Dumating ang padalang kahon mula {hometown}! May limang kilong bigas, tuyo, longganisa, at maikling sulat ni Mama: 'Kain nang maayos, anak. Proud kami sa'yo.'
lines.textEn: A care box arrived from {hometown}! Five kilos of rice, dried fish, homemade longganisa, and Mama's handwritten note: 'Eat well, anak. We are so proud of you.'

choices.text: Tawagan si Mama nang maluha-luha at magluto ng masarap na hapunan!
choices.textEn: Call Mama with happy tears and cook a real home-style dinner!

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Bro, ubos lagi 'yung printing at ballpen sa loob ng building! Mag-tinda tayo ng yellow pad, scantron, at bottled water bago exam weeks!
lines.textEn: Hey, campus stalls always run out of yellow pads and scantrons on exam weeks! Let us sell a mini survival kit!

choices.text: Game! Simulan ang campus supplies hustle! (Play Tusok-Tusok)
choices.textEn: Let us do it! Launch the campus supplies hustle! (Play Selling Game)

choices.text: Baka next week na lang, tambak pa readings ko.
choices.textEn: Maybe next week, buried in readings right now.
